mods.name: Equilibrium
mods.description: Load-aware optimisation that fills gaps left by Sodium/Lithium/ServerCore: hybrid-CPU and X3D aware thread placement via the FFM API, an MSPT governor with hysteresis, lag-adaptive distance-banded AI throttling (DAB-style), a lag-adaptive collision cap, an always-on entity cost sampler, a JVM advisor for Java 25 and a built-in A/B benchmark.
